course.title: Applied AI Engineering
course.subtitle: From first Python concepts to applied AI work
course.description: A self-paced course across five tracks (Foundations, Core AI Engineering, Specializations, Strategy & Governance, and Hands-On Capstones): 50 modules, 330 sub-lessons, and 1,794 bite-sized cards.
course.author: Eric D'Souza
course.licence: Private family licence. Prepared for Eric D'Souza, November 2026. Not for redistribution.

categories.title: Track A: Foundations
categories.summary: Required groundwork. Python here is concepts for reading and directing AI-written code, not a syntax drill.

subCategories.title: A1 Python Concepts for AI-Assisted Development

handsOnProjects: Use an AI assistant to build a small API-calling script, then explain and debug every line
Code-review exercise: find the bugs in AI-generated code
Commit a small project to GitHub with a .gitignore and an environment file so no secrets are exposed
learningOutcomes: Read, understand, and debug Python written by AI
Direct AI coding assistants with clear specs
Keep secrets and keys out of code and version control
toolsAndFrameworks: Python 3, Cursor / VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Jupyter, Google Colab, Git, uv

lessons.title: A1.3 Talking to the Outside World

handsOnProjects: AI-assisted exploratory analysis of a public dataset with a one-page summary
Pull data from an API into a database table, then answer three business questions with SQL
learningOutcomes: Load, clean, explore, and explain real-world data
Query data sources with basic SQL and APIs
Choose between a spreadsheet and a database for a given job
toolsAndFrameworks: pandas, DuckDB, SQLite, Matplotlib, Plotly, Kaggle, Statistics Canada

handsOnProjects: Train and evaluate a simple classifier with AI-generated code and explain the results
Show how accuracy misleads on a lopsided dataset, then fix it with a baseline and better metrics
learningOutcomes: Explain what ML is and how models are trained and evaluated
Recognize overfitting and misleading results
Pick the metric that matches the cost of each kind of error
toolsAndFrameworks: scikit-learn, Google Colab, Teachable Machine

subCategories.title: A4 Neural Networks & How They Learn

handsOnProjects: Fine-tune a pretrained image or text classifier with a few lines of AI-assisted code
Change the learning rate in a playground and describe what happens to training
learningOutcomes: Explain intuitively how neural networks learn
Use pretrained models instead of training from scratch
Explain what parameters, layers, and learning rate each do
toolsAndFrameworks: PyTorch (conceptual), Hugging Face Hub, TensorFlow Playground, Google Colab

handsOnProjects: Sampling lab: vary temperature and top-p and compare outputs
Model-selection memo comparing three LLMs on the same task
Token lab: compare token counts and cost for English text, another language, and code
learningOutcomes: Explain at a conceptual level how LLMs read, predict, and generate text
Anticipate common LLM failure modes before building on them
Explain why tokens, probabilities, and context limits shape model behaviour and cost
toolsAndFrameworks: Hugging Face LLM Course (chapter 1), tiktoken, OpenAI / Anthropic / Google playgrounds, Ollama

lessons.title: A5.3 Transformers at a Conceptual Level

subCategories.title: A6 The AI Stack & Market Map

handsOnProjects: Run the same business task on three models (one closed, one open-weight, one small) and build a cost and quality table
Market map for one use case: the stack you would pick and why
learningOutcomes: Explain the AI stack layer by layer and name leading products in each
Choose models and tools on quality, cost, licence, and data residency
toolsAndFrameworks: OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, LMArena, Artificial Analysis, provider playgrounds

lessons.title: A6.1 The AI Stack in Layers

subLessons.title: The Host Decides Where Data Goes

categories.title: Track B: LLM & Agentic AI Engineering

subCategories.title: B1 Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering & LLM APIs

handsOnProjects: Structured-data extractor that turns messy text into validated JSON
Prompt-chained research assistant with a versioned prompt library and a meta-prompt optimizer
Prompt test set: compare two prompt versions on twenty real cases and report which wins
learningOutcomes: Program LLM behaviour reliably through APIs, prompts, and context
Treat prompts as versioned, testable engineering artifacts
Compare prompt changes on real cases instead of by impression
toolsAndFrameworks: OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs, Pydantic, Instructor, DSPy, tiktoken, prompt playgrounds

handsOnProjects: RAG chatbot over a document collection with source citations
Compare chunking, hybrid search, and re-ranking strategies with retrieval metrics
Index scanned invoices or forms with OCR and answer questions about them with citations
learningOutcomes: Build grounded LLM apps that answer from private data
Diagnose and improve retrieval quality
Handle messy real-world documents, not just clean text
toolsAndFrameworks: sentence-transformers, FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, pgvector, LlamaIndex, LangChain, Cohere Rerank, Docling, Tesseract

subCategories.title: B3 Advanced RAG, Knowledge Graphs & Agentic RAG

handsOnProjects: Graph RAG system that answers multi-hop questions over a knowledge graph
Agentic RAG assistant that decides when and where to search
Text-to-SQL assistant over a sample business database with read-only access and answer checks
learningOutcomes: Model complex relationships with knowledge graphs
Build retrieval that reasons across sources and decides when to retrieve
Choose between documents, graphs, and databases for each kind of question
toolsAndFrameworks: Neo4j, Microsoft GraphRAG, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, LangChain

handsOnProjects: Write a one-page design for an agent: goal, action space, autonomy level, and risks
Convert a rigid workflow into an agent and compare reliability
Choose workflow, single agent, or multi-agent for three business scenarios and defend each choice
learningOutcomes: Explain what makes a system agentic and when to use one
Apply core agent design principles before writing code
Match autonomy to risk before building
toolsAndFrameworks: OpenAI / Anthropic APIs, plain Python, Excalidraw for architecture diagrams

handsOnProjects: Build an agent from scratch (no framework) with search, calculator, and database tools
Build and publish a custom MCP server for a real data source
Tool-reliability lab: inject API failures and measure recovery
Security review of one tool: secrets, permissions, failure modes, and what the agent can reach
learningOutcomes: Give agents reliable, safe, well-designed tools
Connect agents to any tool or data source through MCP
Keep secrets and permissions tight when connecting agents to real systems
toolsAndFrameworks: OpenAI / Anthropic tool-use APIs, Pydantic, MCP SDKs, E2B sandboxes, tenacity

handsOnProjects: Add short-term and long-term (episodic) memory to an assistant and evaluate recall
Semantic cache layer that cuts cost on repeated questions
Compaction experiment: summarize a long conversation and measure what the summary loses
learningOutcomes: Design memory that keeps agents useful across sessions
Engineer context to prevent degradation and control cost
Decide what an agent should remember, summarize, or forget
toolsAndFrameworks: LangGraph memory, Letta (MemGPT), Mem0, Zep, Redis, GPTCache

handsOnProjects: ReAct agent with checkpointed state that survives a forced crash mid-task
Background autonomous agent that monitors a data source and acts on triggers
learningOutcomes: Implement robust single-agent loops
Build agents that recover from failure without starting over
Set budgets, limits, and a named owner for every long-running agent
toolsAndFrameworks: Plain Python, LangGraph checkpointers, Claude Agent SDK, Temporal, Inngest

handsOnProjects: Plan-and-execute research agent with a reflection step
Compare CoT, ToT, and reflection on a reasoning benchmark
Thinking-budget experiment: compare cost and accuracy at different reasoning settings
learningOutcomes: Apply planning and reasoning patterns to complex goals
Use reflection to measurably improve agent reliability
Decide when extra reasoning is worth its cost
toolsAndFrameworks: LangGraph, DSPy, OpenAI / Anthropic reasoning models

handsOnProjects: Implement all five core workflow patterns on one task and compare quality, cost, and latency
Multi-provider router that cuts cost without hurting eval scores
learningOutcomes: Pick the simplest workflow pattern that solves the problem
Combine routing, parallelization, and feedback loops
Combine patterns without adding steps that do not improve results
toolsAndFrameworks: Plain Python asyncio, LangGraph, LiteLLM, OpenRouter

handsOnProjects: Multi-agent system (researcher, writer, critic) built in LangGraph and CrewAI and compared
n8n workflow that triggers a Python agent team via webhook
Failure lab: inject errors into a multi-agent team and trace which agent caused each failure
learningOutcomes: Architect multi-agent systems with the right orchestration approach
Choose and combine frameworks without lock-in
Spot cost, error, and coordination problems in multi-agent systems
toolsAndFrameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework, n8n, A2A

handsOnProjects: Add guardrails, sandboxing, and approval steps to an agent that takes real actions
Run an agent in shadow mode against historical human decisions
Design the approval gates for an agent that touches money, email, or customer data
learningOutcomes: Build agents that are safe to give real permissions
Design human oversight and UX that users trust
Choose which actions need approval and keep the approval step meaningful
toolsAndFrameworks: Guardrails AI, NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, LangGraph interrupts, E2B, Docker

subCategories.title: B12 Evaluation of AI Systems & Agents

handsOnProjects: Eval harness for your RAG app and agent with an LLM-judge and a ground-truth set
Generate a synthetic test suite and set up automated regression checks in CI
Compare two prompt versions with confidence intervals and decide whether the difference is real
learningOutcomes: Measure AI quality rigorously instead of relying on vibes
Catch regressions before they reach users
Tell a real improvement from noise
toolsAndFrameworks: Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, OpenAI Evals, LangSmith, Braintrust, Inspect

handsOnProjects: Deploy a containerized agent API to AWS with FastAPI and CI/CD
Add a multi-provider gateway with fallbacks and rate limits
Pin a model version, then rehearse a migration to a newer model behind an eval gate
learningOutcomes: Take an AI prototype to a reliable production service
Operate the full prompt and model lifecycle for LLM apps
Plan for model retirement and updates
toolsAndFrameworks: FastAPI, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, LiteLLM, Modal

handsOnProjects: Cut the cost of an existing app by 50% while maintaining eval scores
Instrument an agent with full telemetry and a live cost dashboard
learningOutcomes: Balance quality, cost, and latency with data
Observe, trace, and audit AI systems in production
Report cost per completed task, not just cost per token
toolsAndFrameworks: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Helicone, Grafana

handsOnProjects: Red-team an LLM agent against the OWASP lists for LLM and agentic applications and write a remediation report
Responsible-AI assessment (model card + risk register) for a project
Threat-model one agent: map what it can read, what it can do, and where untrusted input enters
learningOutcomes: Secure AI systems against modern attacks
Apply responsible-AI and governance practices to real projects
Treat everything an agent reads as untrusted input
toolsAndFrameworks: OWASP Top 10 lists for LLM and agentic applications, Garak, PyRIT, Fairlearn, NIST AI RMF

subCategories.title: B16 Agentic AI Architecture Capstone Studio

handsOnProjects: Design, build, evaluate, and deploy a production-grade multi-agent system with guardrails, memory, MCP tools, and observability
Architecture document for your own use case, using the layered framework and decision records
learningOutcomes: Architect and defend a complete agentic AI system end to end
Operate at the level of an applied AI engineer
Document an architecture with layers, decisions, and reference designs for your own use case
toolsAndFrameworks: Any of the Core stack: LangGraph / Agents SDK, MCP, Langfuse, Ragas, FastAPI, Docker

handsOnProjects: Implement gradient descent from scratch in NumPy to fit a line
Visualize PCA on a real dataset and explain the components
learningOutcomes: Explain the math behind how models learn
Read ML papers and docs without being blocked by notation
toolsAndFrameworks: NumPy, SymPy, Matplotlib, 3Blue1Brown / Khan Academy references

handsOnProjects: Build and compare three classifiers on a tabular dataset with a written model card
Customer segmentation with clustering and UMAP visualization
learningOutcomes: Choose, train, and evaluate the right classical model for a problem
Detect leakage and justify model choices with proper metrics
toolsAndFrameworks: scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, Optuna

handsOnProjects: Train an image classifier with transfer learning
Write a full PyTorch training loop with logging and checkpoints
learningOutcomes: Build, train, and debug neural networks in PyTorch
Explain how architecture choices affect performance
toolsAndFrameworks: PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, torchvision, Weights & Biases, Google Colab

handsOnProjects: Train a model with mixed precision and compare optimizers and schedules
Build a small diffusion model or VAE and visualize its latent space
learningOutcomes: Train and tune deep models beyond the basics
Choose architectures and losses for specialist problems
toolsAndFrameworks: PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, Hugging Face Accelerate, PyTorch Geometric, Weights & Biases

handsOnProjects: Build a tiny character-level transformer from scratch
Implement a KV cache and measure generation speed-up
learningOutcomes: Explain transformer internals mathematically
Reason about inference speed and memory
toolsAndFrameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, nanoGPT, tokenizers

handsOnProjects: Fine-tune a small open model with QLoRA for a domain task
Preference-tune a model with DPO and compare against SFT
Evaluate a fine-tuned model against the base model with a strong prompt
learningOutcomes: Decide when fine-tuning is worth it and execute it efficiently
Align models with preference data
Show that fine-tuning beat the simpler alternatives
toolsAndFrameworks: Hugging Face TRL, PEFT, Unsloth, Axolotl, bitsandbytes, OpenAI fine-tuning API

handsOnProjects: Distill a large-model behaviour into a small, cheap model
Quantize and self-host an open model with vLLM and benchmark it
Compare one model at two quantization levels on your own task
learningOutcomes: Shrink models while preserving quality
Serve open models efficiently
toolsAndFrameworks: llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, bitsandbytes, AutoAWQ, Modal

handsOnProjects: Voice agent that answers questions about uploaded documents and images
Multimodal RAG over a slide deck or scientific PDF
learningOutcomes: Build applications that combine text, images, and audio
Choose the right modality pipeline for a problem
toolsAndFrameworks: Current vision-language models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, Whisper, CLIP, Stable Diffusion, LiveKit

handsOnProjects: Build an automated train-evaluate-deploy pipeline with drift monitoring
learningOutcomes: Operate ML models across their full lifecycle
Automate training, deployment, and monitoring
toolsAndFrameworks: MLflow, DVC, Airflow / Prefect, Evidently, GitHub Actions

handsOnProjects: Pull a gene's sequence, annotation, and protein structure from public databases
learningOutcomes: Speak the language of molecular biology and genomics
Find and access the right public biological data
toolsAndFrameworks: NCBI, Ensembl, UniProt, PDB, Biopython

handsOnProjects: Inspect, filter, and summarize real FASTQ, BAM, and VCF files
learningOutcomes: Read and manipulate standard sequencing file formats
Work comfortably on the command line and HPC
toolsAndFrameworks: Linux shell, samtools, bcftools, bedtools, Biopython, pysam

handsOnProjects: Run an nf-core RNA-seq or miRNA-seq pipeline end to end and interpret results
Single-cell clustering and annotation of a public dataset
learningOutcomes: Build and run reproducible omics pipelines
Interpret QC, alignment, variant, and expression outputs
toolsAndFrameworks: Nextflow, nf-core, Snakemake, FastQC, MultiQC, BWA, STAR, Salmon, GATK, DESeq2, Scanpy, Seurat

subCategories.title: D4 Machine Learning on Omics Data

handsOnProjects: miRNA-seq biomarker classifier for early cancer detection with rigorous external validation
Survival model on TCGA data with pathway interpretation
Re-run a biomarker model with patient-level splits and compare it with a leaky split
learningOutcomes: Build trustworthy ML models on omics data
Translate model features into biological insight
Show how leakage inflates results
toolsAndFrameworks: scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, lifelines, GSEApy, TCGA, GEO

handsOnProjects: Predict variant effects with protein language model embeddings
Fine-tune a DNA language model for a classification task
learningOutcomes: Apply modern deep learning models to biological sequences and structures
Evaluate the limits of biological AI predictions
toolsAndFrameworks: AlphaFold / ColabFold, ESM, Hugging Face, PyTorch Geometric, RDKit

subCategories.title: D6 LLMs & Agentic AI for Biology

handsOnProjects: Literature-RAG assistant for a disease area with cited answers
Bio agent that runs a QC + expression pipeline via MCP tools and writes a report
Check three claims from an agent-written analysis against sources and a reproduction
learningOutcomes: Connect bioinformatics workflows to LLMs and agents
Build bio agents with scientific validation built in
toolsAndFrameworks: PubMed APIs, LangGraph, MCP, Biopython, Nextflow, Opentrons API

handsOnProjects: Virtual screening workflow with property prediction for a known target
learningOutcomes: Explain where AI adds value across the drug discovery pipeline
Run basic computational screening workflows
toolsAndFrameworks: RDKit, DeepChem, AutoDock Vina, ChEMBL, DiffDock

handsOnProjects: Regulatory and privacy plan for a cancer-detection AI diagnostic
learningOutcomes: Map the path from research model to approved clinical product
Handle sensitive health and genomic data responsibly
toolsAndFrameworks: FDA / Health Canada guidance, Flower (federated learning), synthetic data tools

handsOnProjects: Investment memo or consulting brief on an AI-bio startup or technology
learningOutcomes: Anticipate where AI in biology is heading
Evaluate bio-AI opportunities through scientific, strategic, and investor lenses
toolsAndFrameworks: Crunchbase, PitchBook (if available), ClinicalTrials.gov, company filings

handsOnProjects: AI opportunity map and ROI business case for a real company
Score ten candidate AI use cases for a real company on value, effort, risk, and data readiness
learningOutcomes: Identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities
Build credible ROI cases for AI investment
toolsAndFrameworks: Value-vs-feasibility matrices, spreadsheet ROI models, case studies (e.g., McKinsey, BCG reports)

handsOnProjects: Agentic campaign generator that drafts, evaluates, and A/B-tests content
A/B test AI-written copy against a human baseline and report the result with its uncertainty
learningOutcomes: Apply AI to create, personalize, and measure marketing
Evaluate marketing AI tools against business goals
toolsAndFrameworks: HubSpot AI, Jasper, Google Ads AI, Meta Advantage+, Python MMM tools (Meridian, Robyn)

handsOnProjects: Brand-monitoring agent that tracks sentiment and flags risks
learningOutcomes: Use AI to monitor, protect, and grow a brand
Keep generated content on-brand at scale
toolsAndFrameworks: Brandwatch, Sprinklr, LLM sentiment pipelines, RAG over brand guidelines

subCategories.title: E4 AI for Sales & Customer Service

handsOnProjects: Customer-service agent with RAG over a knowledge base and human handoff
Lead-scoring model plus personalized outreach drafts
Compare an AI support agent with human answers on a sample of real tickets
learningOutcomes: Deploy AI across the sales funnel and support operations
Design escalation paths that protect customer experience
toolsAndFrameworks: Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce, Gong, Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, LangGraph

handsOnProjects: Predictive-maintenance model on sensor data with a cost-savings estimate
Back-office agent that processes invoices end to end
Estimate the savings from automating one invoice or ordering process, including exception handling
learningOutcomes: Apply AI to physical operations and supply chains
Quantify operational impact of AI projects
toolsAndFrameworks: Azure IoT / AWS IoT, Prophet, OR-Tools, UiPath, n8n, Zapier

handsOnProjects: AI adoption roadmap and governance policy for an organization

learningOutcomes: Lead responsible, sustainable AI adoption in an organization
Balance innovation speed with risk and trust

subCategories.title: E7 AI for ERP and MRP

handsOnProjects: Agent that reads an inventory export, runs reorder calculations in code, and drafts purchase orders for approval
Ask-your-data assistant over a sample ERP database with read-only access
Three-way match (purchase order, receipt, invoice) with exception alerts
learningOutcomes: Map a small company's core records and planning logic

lessons.title: E7.1 How ERP and MRP Work

handsOnProjects: Marketing agent team: brief in, reviewed multi-channel drafts and a weekly performance report out

handsOnProjects: Bot team for one business function (e.g., marketing or purchasing) with a manager, specialists, a reviewer, and human approval
Scorecard that shows each bot's quality and cost
learningOutcomes: Turn a business function into a bot team with clear roles and handoffs
Measure and manage a team of bots like a workforce

lessons.title: E9.1 From Org Chart to Bot Team

subCategories.title: E10 Delivering AI Systems for Clients

handsOnProjects: Package one past project as a client proposal with scope, price, and an ROI report
